anomalies.observed: The NXP PCA9685PW PWM/servo driver (U2, FCC Peripherals sheet) is strapped to I2C address 0x41 - the block is annotated 'I2C address: 0x41' and its SCL/SDA pins (26/27) are wired to the same I2C2_SCL_FCC / I2C2_SDA_FCC bus that also carries the INA219 (U1), which is annotated 'I2C address: 0x40' with A0 (pin 7) and A1 (pin 8) tied to GND.
anomalies.expected: The design specification states the PWM/servo driver is 'NXP PCA9685PW (I2C 16-ch PWM), I2C addr 0x40'. The PCA9685 must therefore respond at 0x40; since the INA219 on the same I2C2_FCC bus already occupies 0x40, the two devices cannot both be addressed as the specification describes.

evidence.quote: | PWM/servo driver | FCCPeripherals | NXP PCA9685PW (I2C 16-ch PWM), I2C addr 0x40 |
| Current/voltage sensor | Hades (top sheet) | TI INA219AIDCNR, I2C addr 0x40, across R1 = 10 mΩ shunt |
FCC Peripherals sheet, PWM Driver block: 'I2C address: 0x41' below U2 PCA9685PW; SCL pin 26 = I2C2_SCL_FCC, SDA pin 27 = I2C2_SDA_FCC
Power sheet, Voltage/Current/Power Sense IC block: 'I2C address: 0x40' below U1 INA219AIDCNR; SDA pin 6 = I2C2_SDA_FCC, SCL pin 5 = I2C2_SCL_FCC, A0 pin 7 and A1 pin 8 to GND

anomalies.impact: Firmware written against the specified design (PCA9685 at 0x40) would fail to initialise the servo driver and no PWM output would be produced; the address strapping/adressing of the PWM driver on I2C2_FCC differs from the intended design.

parsed.summary: The only verifiable deviation from the specification is the PWM/servo driver: the schematic straps U2 (PCA9685PW) to I2C address 0x41 and puts it on the same I2C2_FCC bus as the INA219 at 0x40, whereas the specification lists the PCA9685PW at 0x40. All other checked items (shunt value, buck feedback ratio, 15 uH inductor, EEPROM/TMP100/IIS2MDC/MPRLS/BMI088 addresses, MCU part numbers, power rails and the documented barometer RESET/EOC mix-up) match the specification.
